1 .  Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 34/2025 dated 14.01.2025, registered at Police Station Mukherjee Nagar for commission of offences under Section 376/506 IPC.
2.
As per allegations appearing in the FIR, prosecutrix, aged 35 years, reported the police that she had met applicant herein in the year 2018 through social media and they became friends.

According to her, in December, 2019, she was taken to a shop by the applicant where he sexually assaulted her and threatened her not to disclose anything about the alleged incident to anyone else, he would inform her husband about the aforesaid incident.
According to her, even thereafter, applicant pressurised her to meet him regularly and gave false promises to her that he would marry her, after giving divorce to his wife.

sentences.text: It is submitted that the complainant herself is a married lady having two children.

Certain whatsapp chats have been placed on record between the complainant and the applicant's wife and between the applicant and the complainant to demonstrate that the relationship between the applicant and the complainant was consensual in nature.
It is further submitted that the applicant is ready to join the investigation as and when directed by the Investigating Officer and he shall cooperate in the investigation.

5. Per contra, learned APP, on instructions from the Investigating Officer, submits that the applicant is not joining investigation and Non-Bailable Warrants (NBWs)
have been issued against him from the concerned learned Trial Court.
It is further pointed out that the applicant has not surrendered his mobile phone which is required for the purpose of investigation.
On a pointed query to the Investigating Officer with regard to the whatsapp chats placed on record, it is submitted the same has not been supplied to her and requires investigation.

6. Issue notice.
7.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file a further status report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing.
8. Response, if any, by the complainant/survivour be placed on record before the next date of hearing.

5. Applicant has, reportedly, surrendered his one such mobile with the investigating agency which has already been sent to Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL) for evaluation.
However, there is a grievance from the side of investigating agency that the applicant had one more mobile phone which has yet not surrendered.

Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant, in fact, had another mobile but such mobile was sold by him in October, 2022 when he had purchased other mobile phone, which is already in possession of the investigating agency.

sentences.text: 6. When asked, learned APP for the State submitted that investigation is already over and challan is under scrutiny.
7. Learned counsel for complainant is also present with complainant and have been heard.

8. Keeping in mind the overall facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the aforesaid interim relief was given more than a year back and there is no instance of its being misused by the applicant in any manner whatsoever, the aforesaid order dated 27.02.2025 is made absolute with the condition that applicant shall continue to join further investigation as and when so called by the investigating agency and in the event of his arrest, the concerned SHO/IO/arresting officer shall release him on bail on his furnishing personal bond and surety bond in a sum of Rs. 25,000/- each.
9. Needless to say, applicant shall not contact the prosecutrix, directly or indirectly, and would not try to intimidate or influence her in any manner This is a digitally signed order.

11. Application stands disposed of in aforesaid terms.
